text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon hasn't been doing well
lately, so we
visit a local shrine for a
change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We offer up our prayers for her
condition to
improve, draw our fortune
slips, and then...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, can I ask you a question, Trainer? I
know
that the gods are mysterious
beings and all...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But even so, they're basically household
names,
right? Do you think they're on
Umastagram?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, if I'm gonna become a top
Umadol, I've
gotta do whatever it takes
to get back in peak
condition...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So I was thinking I should try showing
the gods
just how cute I am!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I figure they might answer my prayers
even faster
that way! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Really? I guess it's pretty difficult to talk
to them
directly...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's fine if they don't answer, but I still
want to
show them how cute I can be
somehow.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Look! There's a spot for hanging up
fortune slips
over there!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That gives me a great idea! Gimme just a
sec,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon takes out the pen she uses
for
autographs and begins to scribble
something on
her fortune slip...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Dear gods, please watch over me and
help me
get better! ♪" ...Yep, that looks
nice and cute!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Now if I hang this up, they'll definitely
answer my
prayer! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll go and hang it up now!
Ooh, I
know—I should fold it into a heart
shape! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe! Looking good! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To the gods watching over me from
above... Just
so you know, I poured my
whole heart into my
prayer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So please! Pretty please! Give me a
bunch of
positive energy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it's because of her prayer
or not,
but a few days later, Smart
Falcon sees a
remarkable improvement!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rrrrip!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Aaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: O-oh no! My fortune slip tore!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
How am I supposed to show the gods
how cute I
am noooow?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The unfortunate outcome seems to come
as quite
a shock to Smart Falcon... and
perhaps as a
result, her condition
doesn't show much
improvement.
